title: AnomalyDINO: Boosting Patch-based Few-Shot Anomaly Detection with DINOv2
mechanism: Training-free patch nearest-neighbour scoring on DINOv2 features against a few normal reference images.
adaptation: References = clean pool cells of the same source and layout (half-cut references from the 1,152 pool half-cells); 448 px input with ViT-S/14 and ViT-L/14; map used as an extra input channel or gating prior for inactive and for E1 recall; also the pseudo-target generator for AGSSP-EL.
min_experiment: Offline recall study as for MuSc (F51/H36), then add the map as a 2nd input channel to PF U-Net++, 5 seeds; metric inactive IoU (test, 5-fold CV) and E1 inactive IoU; kill if inactive IoU gain < +0.02 on CV.
evidence: R: one-shot MVTec-AD image AUROC 93.1 to 96.6; training-free.
prior_overlap: none; anomaly priors never tried. Frozen DINOv2-S linear probe (segmentation) is a different use.

alt_notes.adaptation: References = pool cells of the same source and layout that the house ensemble calls clean (pool contains defects, so filter the memory bank SoftPatch-style); 1,152 pool half-cells give half-cut references for E1; 448 px, ViT-S/14 and ViT-L/14; map as prior channel or logit fusion.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Offline recall test as above; baseline PF ensemble; kill if < 30% of house-missed components recovered at 1% flagged area.
